title: Research: exact rank-three common-sum anchor screen
body:
## Result

Adds an exact reversible **rank-three common-sum output anchor** for `q=2..112` and screens two disjoint `q=112` blocks against the pinned selected local-word ceiling. This is a local construction and conditional moment result. It does **not** claim selected-provider placement, a new `κ`, or a tensor-rank minimum.

For each block, the clean anchor is `F0=x0*y0+x1*y1+x2*y2`; each dirty output receives `F0+x_(i+2)*y_(i+2)`. The schedule uses 114 rank-one products and 111 explicit affine fanout additions, versus 447 rank-one products for separate evaluation. Two blocks save 666 rank-one products. Exact profile screening gives about a 14.2% ceiling gain; 411 added rank-one-equivalent child charges still pass the pinned 5% gate and 412 fail. Fanout ADDs remain a separate cost line.

## Evidence and reproduction

From the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/complex-rank3-anchor-seed3f73/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-rank3-anchor-seed3f73 --check-only
```

Expected direct result:

```text
PASS_RANK3_SUM_ANCHOR q=2..112 products=114 fanouts=111 two_blocks_saved=666 cap_extra=411/412 local_only
```

The verifier symbolically checks forward and reverse schedules for every `q=2..112`, exhausts all 32,768 `q=4` input/dirty-output states, rejects three malformed controls, and recomputes exact rational ceiling brackets and the 411/412 boundary. The package pins the selected result, review, source manifest, assembly certificate, catalogue, and ceiling implementation. Local replay used Python 3.14.7; repository generic replay uses Python 3.12 and will provide the hosted run.

## Scope and limits

The provider source map is not established. A realization must bind products to the selected gauge44 program and invoice source access, helper operations, frame changes, copying, hosting, precision, restoration, interface transitions, and the 222 fanout ADDs before this profile can affect the selected construction. No selected frontier or exponent is changed.

This extends the local rank-two anchor handoff in [Discussion #1167, comment 18931234](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1167#discussioncomment-18931234) with one more shared anchor product and a distinct local schedule. The prior literal-recipe multiplicity observation is not used as a fanout bound; the withdrawn inference is documented in the task metadata and claim.

Seed `3f73d5ee4dbd507bc342bd8da6003a48`; track `complex-mechanisms`; task `complex-new-helper-inventory`; base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`; selected-record SHA-256 `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`. The bounded contract and cost screen are intended to be reviewable independently of the unresolved placement question. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance is disclosed in the package.
